name: MG 42 on the Lafette, set low
about: Made by tools/battle-models (prop). Metres; x forward, y right, z up. A battle model: `part` says which part each point belongs to; `parts` are the parts (parent, pivot, axis of turning, way of sliding); `sockets` are named places for flash, smoke, fire and wake; `clips` move the parts. Turns: +t degrees about an axis carries p to p cos t + (axis x p) sin t + axis (axis . p)(1 - cos t), about the part's pivot. Paints: 0 upper, 1 upper2, 2 shade, 3 track, 4 rubber, 5 steel, 6 bright, 7 wood, 8 canvas, 9 glass, 10 black, 11 rust, 12 lamp, 13 white, 14 red, 15 yellow, 16 blue, 17 leather, 18 torn, 19 rope, 20 cloth, 21 skin, 22 brass, 23 bakelite, 24 link, 25 bullet, 26 rounds, 27 dark, 28 earth, 29 mount, 30 box, 31 flute

parts.name: mount
parts.note: on the ground under the cradle's front pivot; the game places it

parts.name: cradle
parts.note: swings about the cradle's front pivot along the arc: + the muzzle to the right

parts.name: gun
parts.note: the cradle and the gun tip about the cradle's front: + the muzzle up; and what is carried on a shoulder

parts.name: box
parts.note: the belt box and the fold of belt in it: swung with the gun about the pintle (the number two shifts it as she swings), so the belt always runs into its mouth; it stays on the ground

sockets.name: grip.gunner.l
sockets.note: the gunner's left hand on the elevating wheel (or steadying the butt)

sockets.name: grip.gunner.r
sockets.note: the gunner's right hand on the cradle's trigger handle

sockets.name: sight
sockets.note: the optical sight's eyepiece: the gunner's eye for long fire

sockets.name: muzzle
sockets.note: the muzzle: the flash and the tracer

sockets.name: feed
sockets.note: the belt comes in here from the left: the number two's hands

sockets.name: shoulder
sockets.note: the butt: the gunner's right shoulder

sockets.name: box
sockets.note: the belt box on the ground at the gun's left, end-on to her, its lid swung up at the far end

sockets.name: seat
sockets.note: the gunner's root, lying behind her a little to the left: his right shoulder at the butt 0.47 m ahead, his eye by the sight

sockets.name: seat.loader
sockets.note: the number two, lying at her left by the belt box

traverse.what: the game swings the gun left and right about the pintle (+ to the right)

elevate.what: the game lays the muzzle up and down (+ up)

recoil.what: a shake of 3 to 5 mm back along the barrel on each round of a burst (the game's own; no clip)

gunner.what: how the gunner serves her: prone (lying behind, his elbows down) or sit (sitting on the ground behind, his knees up either side)

feed.what: the side the belt or the strip comes in from, and so where the number two is (socket seat.loader). The belt's fed end is part of the gun and turns with her; the box and the fold of belt in it stand on the ground

carry.what: when the team moves: the game shows the `gun` part alone on the gunner's shoulder (cradle and gun together), and puts the mount away until the number two has a clip that carries it
carry.fire: long bursts of 8 to 12 at 1,200 a minute (the MG 42; the MG 34 at 850), a pause, again

units: German machine gun teams from the summer of 1942
